notes: Small reviewed catalog. Candidate retrieval is not applicability; applicability is not violation. ENGINEERING review means the mechanical predicate was implemented and tested by Devin; it is not human or legal review. FIX/REVIEW actions are repair recommendations, not legal findings.

rules.title: Google Ads Misrepresentation — Misleading ad design: inconsistencies between the ad and the landing page
rules.excerpt: Inconsistencies between the ad and the landing page/app.
required_facts: validated evidence quote from the supplied landing page snapshot

review.role: automated engineering review — NOT human or legal review

rules.implementation_notes: Mechanical: an objective ad/image claim whose supplied landing-page evidence (validated quote and/or deterministic arithmetic) establishes a mismatch. Does not judge ad design generally (buttons, notifications, ad labeling are NOT implemented).

rules.title: Google Ads Misrepresentation — Unreliable claims: inaccurate claims
rules.excerpt: Making inaccurate claims or claims that entice the user with an improbable result (even if this result is possible) as the likely outcome a user can expect is not allowed.
required_facts: validated evidence quote from a supplied seller/substantiation source

review.role: automated engineering review — NOT human or legal review

rules.implementation_notes: Mechanical subset only: an objective claim directly CONTRADICTED by the supplied seller evidence is treated as inaccurate. 'Improbable result' judgments, and INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE claims, are NOT treated as violations of this rule (insufficient evidence is reported as an evidence finding, not a policy violation).

rules.title: Google Ads — Dishonest pricing practices: false or misleading impression of cost
rules.excerpt: Employing pricing practices that create a false or misleading impression of the cost of a product or service, leading to inflated or unexpected charges is not allowed.
required_facts: evidence of inflated or unexpected charges
rules.implementation_notes: DRAFT pending human review: whether an overstated discount alone creates 'inflated or unexpected charges' is an interpretation. Not required by the v1 pack; price mismatches are covered by the ad/landing-page inconsistency rule.

rules.title: Google Ads — Dishonest pricing practices: disclose payment model and full expense
rules.excerpt: Failure to clearly and conspicuously disclose the payment model or full expense that a user will bear before and after purchase is not allowed.
rules.implementation_notes: DRAFT / NOT IMPLEMENTED: requires taxes, fees, shipping and billing facts AdProof does not extract. Listed as an explicitly excluded check in the v1 pack.

rules.title: Google Ads — Unreliable claims: testimonials claiming specific results
rules.section: Unreliable claims — Claims related to health and weight loss (testimonials)
rules.excerpt: Testimonials that claim specific results must include a visible disclaimer stating that there is no guarantee of specific results and that the results can vary.
rules.implementation_notes: DRAFT: appears under the health/weight-loss subsection; applicability to electronics endorsements is ambiguous and needs human review. Not required by v1.

rules.title: Google Ads — Unreliable claims: unproven health cures
rules.section: Unreliable claims — Claims related to health and weight loss
rules.excerpt: Making unproven claims of cures for incurable medical ailments
rules.implementation_notes: DISABLED: health category is out of the v1 launch scope. Any health claim is routed to HUMAN_REVIEW as unsupported scope rather than evaluated against this rule.

rules.title: FTC Policy Statement Regarding Advertising Substantiation
rules.implementation_notes: DRAFT / SOURCE NOT RETRIEVED: www.ftc.gov returned HTTP 404 to the build VM's automated fetch (bot blocking suspected). No excerpt is recorded; a human must retrieve and review the exact section before any activation.
